blocks.en: The career agents (like nearly all other agents) can be accessed through the Station Services window at their station. Right-click on an agent to start a conversation with them.
blocks.zh: 生涯代理人（和几乎所有其他代理人一样）可以在其所在空间站的空间站服务窗口中找到。右键点击代理人即可开始对话。

blocks.en: The Career Agents are a part of EVE Online's new player training. Following on from the tutorial, the career agents offer missions that showcase and explain some of the main PvE activities in EVE Online, as well as expand on the topics covered in the tutorial. There are five career agents, each offering between 5 and 10 sequential missions covering a certain area of the game:
blocks.zh: 生涯代理人（Career Agents）是 EVE Online 新手训练的一部分。生涯代理人承接教程，提供的任务会展示并讲解 EVE Online 中一些主要的 PvE 活动，并对教程中涉及的主题加以扩展。生涯代理人共有五位，每位提供 5 到 10 个连续任务，涵盖游戏的某个领域：

en: Explorer, which teach you about exploration, probe scanning, hacking, and gas cloud harvesting.
Enforcer, which teach you about basic PvE combat.
Soldier of Fortune, which teach you about advanced PvE combat as well as some basic PvP combat techniques.
Industrialist - Entrepreneur, which teach you about hauling, salvaging, mining, hacking, and manufacturing.
Industrialist - Producer, which teach you about mining, reprocessing, manufacturing, and hauling.
zh: 探险家（Explorer），教你探索、探针扫描、破解和气云采集。
执法者（Enforcer），教你基础的 PvE 战斗。
自由战士（Soldier of Fortune），教你进阶的 PvE 战斗以及一些基础的 PvP 战斗技巧。
工业家 - 企业家（Industrialist - Entrepreneur），教你运输、打捞、采矿、破解和制造。
工业家 - 生产者（Industrialist - Producer），教你采矿、提炼、制造和运输。

blocks.en: The agents are not exclusive (i.e. doing one set of missions doesn't "lock" you into a pre-set "career path", as there are no such things in EVE); you can do as many of the agents' missions as you want. There are 12 locations in total, 3 for each of the four empires in New Eden.
blocks.zh: 这些代理人并不互斥（也就是说，做了某一组任务并不会把你“锁定”在某条预设的“职业道路”上，EVE 里根本没有这种东西）；你想做多少位代理人的任务都可以。生涯代理人共有 12 个地点，新伊甸四大帝国各 3 个。

blocks.en: It is highly recommended that you complete all the mission chains (or arcs if you will) given by the five career agents, even if you already know what you'd like to do in EVE. The missions give a good overview of some of the mechanics of the game, and good financial rewards for a new player. It is also good to have a basic idea of how each career works - for example, even if you don't plan to do any exploration, it is good to have an idea of how other players are able to scan and find you while you are in space doing any number of activities. Also, it's likely that over the course of your time in EVE you will want to try doing many different things.
blocks.zh: 强烈建议你完成五位生涯代理人提供的所有任务链（或者说任务线），即使你已经清楚自己想在 EVE 里做什么。这些任务能让你很好地了解游戏的一些机制，而且对新玩家来说经济回报也不错。对每种职业的运作方式有个基本了解也是好事——例如，即使你不打算做探索，了解一下其他玩家是如何在你于太空中进行各种活动时扫描并找到你的，也很有用。而且，在你玩 EVE 的过程中，很可能会想尝试许多不同的事情。

blocks.en: If you plan on applying to join EVE University, it is recommended that you have at least started, if not completed, all the career agent missions.
blocks.zh: 如果你打算申请加入 EVE University，建议至少已经开始（最好是完成）所有生涯代理人任务。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 简介

blocks.en: If you're doing the Career Agent missions right after the tutorial, you may notice that some of the mission mechanics have changed.
blocks.zh: 如果你在教程结束后马上开始做生涯代理人任务，可能会注意到有些任务机制有所不同。

en: The currently active mission now shows up in the Info Panel (left side of the screen) under "Agent Missions". Each mission entry has a drop-down menu through which you can read a summary of the objectives. Additionally, once you've completed the objectives for a mission (including, if applicable, returning any items to the correct station), a green tick mark will appear in the Info Panel.
The missions will also be entered into your mission journal
zh: 当前进行中的任务现在会显示在信息面板（屏幕左侧）的“代理人任务”（Agent Missions）下。每个任务条目都有一个下拉菜单，可以查看任务目标摘要。此外，完成任务目标后（包括需要时把物品送回正确的空间站），信息面板中会出现一个绿色勾号。
任务也会被记录到你的任务日志中

blocks.en: With the Viridian expansion the mission journal was removed from the Neocom and the short-cut settings. Its keyboard short-cut was assigned to the newly introduced opportunities window.
blocks.zh: 在Viridian 资料片中，任务日志已从 Neocom 和快捷键设置中移除，原来的快捷键被分配给了新加入的机遇（Opportunities）窗口。

blocks.en: Till the 2nd December 2025, the mission journal could still be called using the slash command /open journal in any of the chat windows.
blocks.zh: 在 2025 年 12 月 2 日之前，仍然可以在任意聊天窗口中使用斜杠命令 /open journal 打开任务日志。

blocks.en: In the Version 23.02 release 2025-12-02.1 CCP announced: Slash commands via chat have been disabled.
blocks.zh: 在 23.02 版本 2025-12-02.1 更新中，CCP 宣布：聊天中的斜杠命令已被禁用。

en: In order to start a mission, you must first talk to the agent (right-click on the agent (in the "Agents" panel in the Station Services window), and select "Start Conversation") and accept a mission. Once you've completed the objectives, you must return to the agent's station, and talk to him/her again to complete it. You will then be offered the next mission in the mission chain.
The career agent missions often give bonus rewards for completing them particularly quickly, although the time-frame given is usually more than generous.

Any agents you accept missions from will be automatically added to your address book (accessible through the Contacts window in the NeoCom). You can use this to find your agent again should you be unsure where to go.
zh: 要开始一个任务，必须先与代理人对话（在空间站服务窗口的“代理人”面板中右键点击代理人，选择“开始对话”）并接受任务。完成任务目标后，必须回到代理人所在的空间站，再次与其对话来完成任务。之后代理人会向你提供任务链中的下一个任务。
生涯代理人任务常常会为特别快速完成的玩家提供额外奖励，不过给出的时限通常都非常宽裕。
你接过任务的代理人都会被自动添加到你的通讯录中（可以通过 NeoCom 中的联系人窗口打开）。如果不确定该去哪里，可以用它重新找到你的代理人。

blocks.en: In many ways, the career agents work similarly to "normal" mission agents in EVE, with two important differences:
blocks.zh: 在很多方面，生涯代理人与 EVE 中“普通”的任务代理人运作方式类似，但有两个重要区别：

en: The career agents only have a limited set of missions available. Normal mission agents will continue to offer you new missions indefinitely as long as you have the required standings
The career agents will sometimes give you ships, modules, or skillbooks as mission rewards. Normal mission agents almost always pay only ISK and loyalty points.
zh: 生涯代理人只有数量有限的任务。普通任务代理人只要你有所需的声望，就会无限地为你提供新任务
生涯代理人有时会把舰船、装备或技能书作为任务奖励。普通任务代理人几乎总是只支付 ISK 和忠诚点（LP）。

blocks.en: It's possible to decline a mission from a Career Agent, but this will prevent you from completing the rest of the missions in that agent's mission arc. Therefore, if you want to take a temporary break from a mission chain, click the "Delay" button (instead of the "Reject" button) when a mission is offered. Should you nonetheless run into problems where you are mid-chain, such as declining the agent (which will prevent you from progressing further with that agent) or any other technical glitches, you can open a support ticket, and usually, a game master (GM) will reset the mission or even the agent for you.
blocks.zh: 你可以拒绝生涯代理人的任务，但这样就无法完成该代理人任务线中剩余的任务。因此，如果你想暂时离开某个任务链，在代理人提供任务时请点击“推迟”（Delay）按钮，而不是“拒绝”（Reject）按钮。如果你在任务链中途仍遇到了问题，例如拒绝了代理人（这会导致你无法继续该代理人的任务）或其他技术故障，可以提交客服工单，通常 GM 会为你重置任务甚至重置代理人。

blocks.en: While many of the rewards from the Career Agents are useful in the rest of the game, some missions reward you with a "Civilian" module. These modules are much worse than even the basic Tech 1 modules and should be ditched at the earliest possible opportunity.
blocks.zh: 虽然生涯代理人的许多奖励在之后的游戏中都很有用，但有些任务奖励的是“民用”装备。这些装备甚至比最基础的 T1 装备还差得多，应该尽早丢掉。

blocks.en: Many of the Career Agent missions have you interacting with objects in space (asteroids, containers, acceleration gates, etc); depending on your Overview settings these may not appear in your Overview. Therefore, the Career Agent missions are a good opportunity to get to know the Overview settings, and (if necessary) modify them so that you can see all the relevant objects in your Overview. If you're unsure whether your Overview settings are wrong (or if you're just in the wrong place), it may be a good idea to look at the "All" Overview preset from time to time.
blocks.zh: 许多生涯代理人任务需要你与太空中的物体互动（小行星、货柜、加速门等）；根据你的总览设置，这些物体可能不会显示在总览中。因此，生涯代理人任务是熟悉总览设置的好机会，必要时可以修改设置，让所有相关物体都能显示在总览中。如果你不确定是总览设置有问题（还是只是走错了地方），不妨时不时看一下“全部”（All）总览预设。

blocks.en: The Career Agents assume that you've done the tutorial (or are at least familiar with the concepts taught in the tutorial) before starting their missions.
blocks.zh: 生涯代理人默认你在开始他们的任务之前已经完成了教程（或者至少熟悉教程中讲授的概念）。

blocks.en: Caveat emptor – techniques are not mechanics
blocks.zh: 买者自慎——技巧不等于机制

blocks.en: However, keep in mind that they offer very little training in PvP (which make up a very substantial part of the game). Additionally, EVE is a sandbox game, and much of the attraction of the game is forging your own path as opposed to following a pre-set path - so the career agent "careers" should only be seen as one of many things you can do in EVE.
blocks.zh: 不过要记住，生涯代理人几乎不提供 PvP 方面的训练（而 PvP 是游戏中非常重要的一部分）。此外，EVE 是一款沙盒游戏，它的魅力很大程度上在于走出自己的道路，而不是沿着预设的路线前进——所以生涯代理人的“职业”只应被看作你在 EVE 中能做的众多事情之一。

blocks.en: Finding the Career Agents
blocks.zh: 寻找生涯代理人

blocks.en: If you've followed the tutorial, you will have flown to the station housing the career agents; all five agents are always located in the same station. If you skipped the tutorial, you can locate the closest set of career agents (there are three sets of agents per faction, but they all offer the same missions):
blocks.zh: 如果你完成了教程，你应该已经飞到了生涯代理人所在的空间站；五位代理人总是在同一个空间站里。如果你跳过了教程，可以按以下步骤找到最近的一组生涯代理人（每个势力有三组代理人，但他们提供的任务都一样）：

en: Open The Agency in-game (Alt+M)
Navigate to the page called "AGENTS & MISSIONS".
Select the card "Career Agents". This will open another window that will present you with the closest Career agents to your current location.

Next to each agent there will be a button labeled "Set Destination", "Dock", and "Start Conversation" depending on where you currently are. If you need to travel there click it to plot a route to the system and station where the agents are.
zh: 在游戏中打开代理处（The Agency，Alt+M）
进入名为“代理人和任务”（AGENTS & MISSIONS）的页面。
选择“生涯代理人”（Career Agents）卡片。这会打开另一个窗口，显示离你当前位置最近的生涯代理人。
根据你当前所在的位置，每位代理人旁边会有“设为目的地”（Set Destination）、“停靠”（Dock）或“开始对话”（Start Conversation）按钮。如果需要过去，点击按钮即可规划一条前往代理人所在星系和空间站的路线。

blocks.en: You can do the agents in any order you like - even accept all 5 and do them in parallel. In fact, the latter has the advantage that some of the rewards of one mission line are requested by another so you need to buy/build/get fewer items to finish the missions.
blocks.zh: 你可以按任意顺序完成这些代理人的任务——甚至可以同时接下全部 5 位的任务并行推进。事实上，并行推进还有个好处：某条任务线的一些奖励正好是另一条任务线所需要的，这样完成任务时需要购买/制造/获取的物品就更少。

blocks.en: There are three sets of five career agents for each Empire faction in the game. They all offer identical missions and equivalent rewards, however, they can be used as a quick way to gain faction standings, as each character can complete all sets of career agents, for all empire factions.
blocks.zh: 游戏中每个帝国势力各有三组、每组五位生涯代理人。他们提供的任务和奖励都完全相同，不过可以用来快速提升势力声望，因为每个角色都可以完成所有帝国势力的所有各组生涯代理人任务。

blocks.en: Considerations for Mission Order
blocks.zh: 任务顺序建议

blocks.en: There is no built-in mission order for the career agents - you can complete them in whichever order you please. There are, however, some benefits to completing one mission chain before another, be it for logical or material reasons.
blocks.zh: 生涯代理人没有固定的任务顺序——你可以按任何顺序完成。不过，无论出于逻辑还是物资方面的原因，先完成某条任务链再做另一条会有一些好处。

blocks.en: Explorer
blocks.zh: 探险家

en: This mission chain does not involve combat or require any mission item to be outsourced, and thus it is an ideal candidate as an earlier choice.
The second mission grants an exploration frigate, which is convenient for most other career missions (large cargo hold, good multi-weapons damages for a new pilot).
The last mission reward is the ship you might want to turn in later for Making Mountains of Molehills (10/10)
zh: 这条任务链不涉及战斗，也不需要从外部获取任何任务物品，因此非常适合优先完成。
第二个任务会奖励一艘探索护卫舰，用来做其他大多数生涯任务都很方便（货舱大，对新飞行员来说多种武器的伤害都不错）。
最后一个任务奖励的舰船，之后你可能会想上交给Making Mountains of Molehills (10/10) 任务

blocks.en: Enforcer
blocks.zh: 执法者

en: Everything you need for the missions is internally supplied, and thus it is an ideal candidate as an earlier choice.
zh: 任务所需的一切都由任务内部提供，因此非常适合优先完成。

en: While your corvette is more than sufficient for the first two missions before a more combat-appropriate frigate is granted to you as a reward for Cash Flow for Capsuleers (2/10), you can try out the two frigates rewarded from the Explorer should you wish, as they will likely be an upgrade compared to the corvette.
zh: 在 Cash Flow for Capsuleers (2/10) 奖励你一艘更适合战斗的护卫舰之前，你的轻型护卫舰完全足以应付前两个任务；不过如果你愿意，也可以试试探险家任务奖励的两艘护卫舰，它们很可能比轻型护卫舰更强。

blocks.en: Soldier of Fortune
blocks.zh: 自由战士

en: Since this mission chain deals with more advanced PvE combat topics, for the new players it is suggested that you complete Enforcer first. However, the final mission of this chain rewards a T1 destroyer, which could be used to complete the Enforcer missions more quickly, thanks to their significantly increased firepower vs frigates.
zh: 由于这条任务链涉及更进阶的 PvE 战斗内容，建议新玩家先完成执法者任务。不过，这条任务链的最后一个任务会奖励一艘 T1 驱逐舰，由于火力比护卫舰强得多，可以用它更快地完成执法者任务。

en: In addition, The Exam (10/10) might pose a challenge for those who do not yet have a combat-appropriate frigate from Cash Flow for Capsuleers (2/10) or the necessary skill injected and trained to use the destroyer granted to you when the mission is accepted.
zh: 此外，如果你还没有从 Cash Flow for Capsuleers (2/10) 拿到适合战斗的护卫舰，或者还没有注入并训练驾驶接任务时发给你的驱逐舰所需的技能，The Exam (10/10) 可能会有些难度。

en: Tip #1: Angel of Mercy (2/10) and The Stand (5/10) require you to fly a frigate to its destruction. Do not fit any modules on it other than what you need to complete the mission, and get it Platinum-level insured before you undock for a quick and easy pay-out on mission completion.
zh: 技巧 1：Angel of Mercy (2/10) 和 The Stand (5/10) 需要你驾驶一艘护卫舰直到它被击毁。除了完成任务所需的装备外，不要装任何其他装备，并在离站前为它购买白金级保险，这样任务完成时就能快速轻松地拿到赔付。

en: Tip #2: The Stand (5/10) requires you to do some damage, so you'll need weapons, that you can buy at your own expense (with their ammunition) to other players at the agent's station, or bring your own ammunition and modules before you start the mission chain from a place with lower prices. Alternatively you can use the ship provided, insure it, and fit it with 3 to 4 free turrets and 1 free afterburner taken from a free corvette, it will provide enough damage for the mission. It will require you to repackage/assemble your corvette several times and then take the free modules from item hangar.
zh: 技巧 2：The Stand (5/10) 要求你造成一定伤害，所以你需要武器。你可以自费在代理人所在空间站向其他玩家购买武器（及弹药），或者在开始任务链之前从价格更低的地方带上自己的弹药和装备。另外，你也可以使用任务提供的舰船，给它上保险，再装上从免费轻型护卫舰上拆下来的 3 到 4 门免费炮台和 1 个免费加力燃烧器，这样的伤害就足以完成任务。这需要你把轻型护卫舰打包/组装好几次，然后从物品机库中取出免费装备。

en: Tip #3 (for experienced players only): While you need to use the frigate provided in Angel of Mercy (2/10), you can choose to use a free corvette (with a second civilian gun instead of the mining laser) for The Stand (5/10), but it requires to pilot the ship the right way (orbit at 1000m with afterburner on) and warp to the site using missions details sheet since mission tracking UI on the left won't let you warp on the site without the granted frigate.
zh: 技巧 3（仅限有经验的玩家）：虽然 Angel of Mercy (2/10) 必须使用任务提供的护卫舰，但 The Stand (5/10) 你可以选择使用免费的轻型护卫舰（把采矿激光器换成第二门民用炮），不过这需要用正确的方式驾驶（开着加力燃烧器以 1000m 环绕），并通过任务详情页跃迁到站点，因为不驾驶任务提供的护卫舰时，左侧的任务追踪界面不允许你跃迁到站点。

blocks.en: Industrialist - Entrepreneur
blocks.zh: 工业家 - 企业家

en: Balancing the Books (9/10) requires two 1MN Afterburner modules, one of which needs to be acquired outside of the mission chain. If you complete either Enforcer: Cash Flow for Capsuleers (4/10) or Industrialist - Producer: Making Mountains of Molehills (5/10) beforehand, you can use these mission rewards to immediately complete the mission.
zh: Balancing the Books (9/10) 需要两个 1MN 加力燃烧器，其中一个需要在任务链之外获取。如果你事先完成了 执法者：Cash Flow for Capsuleers (4/10) 或 工业家 - 生产者：Making Mountains of Molehills (5/10)，就可以用这些任务奖励立即完成该任务。

en: Balancing the Books (10/10) requires some faction-specific ammunition, which you can manufacture or purchase from the market. If you are doing this mission for a Gallente or Minmatar agent, you can use leftover ammunition which comes as a bonus reward by Enforcer: Cash Flow for Capsuleers (1/10) for at least a partial supply of required items.
zh: Balancing the Books (10/10) 需要一些特定势力的弹药，你可以自己制造或从市场购买。如果你是为盖伦特或米玛塔尔代理人做这个任务，可以用 执法者：Cash Flow for Capsuleers (1/10) 额外奖励中剩下的弹药，至少能凑齐一部分所需物品。

blocks.en: Industrialist - Producer
blocks.zh: 工业家 - 生产者

en: Making Mountains of Molehills (4/10) and (8/10) require 7,000 and 2,640 units of Tritanium respectively, which you can reprocess from the ores you mine or buy from the market. Should you wish to mine and reprocess yourself, a Venture mining frigate given by Industrialist - Entrepreneur mission: Balancing the Books (2/10) may come in handy due to its mining speed and spacious orehold capacity. Alternatively, exploration frigates given out by Explorer mission: An Introduction to Cosmic Signatures (2/5) is also a good candidate for mining for this mission (although not for mining in general) as they usually have the largest cargohold capacity within the non-mining frigate class to minimize the number of mining trips you have to make.
zh: Making Mountains of Molehills (4/10) 和 (8/10) 分别需要 7,000 和 2,640 单位三钛合金，可以通过提炼自己开采的矿石获得，也可以从市场购买。如果你想自己采矿和提炼，工业家 - 企业家任务：Balancing the Books (2/10) 奖励的冲锋者级采矿护卫舰可能会派上用场，因为它采矿速度快，矿石舱容量大。另外，探险家任务：An Introduction to Cosmic Signatures (2/5) 奖励的探索护卫舰也很适合用来为这个任务采矿（但一般不适合用来采矿），因为它们的货舱通常是非采矿护卫舰中最大的，可以尽量减少往返采矿的次数。

en: Making Mountains of Molehills (9 of 10) Mining 4,000 units of Kernite before completing this mission and then reprocessing it will complete both the mining and reprocessing Kernite AIR Career Program industrialist tasks.
zh: Making Mountains of Molehills (9 of 10)：在完成这个任务之前开采 4,000 单位水硼砂，然后提炼掉，就能同时完成 AIR 职业计划中开采和提炼水硼砂这两项工业家任务。

en: Making Mountains of Molehills (10/10) requires a faction-specific frigate which you can either manufacture or purchase from the market. Alternatively, if you have already completed Explorer mission: Gas Site Scanning (5/5) and have the rewarded frigate intact, you can turn it in to immediately complete the mission.
zh: Making Mountains of Molehills (10/10) 需要一艘特定势力的护卫舰，你可以自己制造或从市场购买。另外，如果你已经完成了 探险家任务：Gas Site Scanning (5/5)，并且奖励的护卫舰还完好无损，就可以直接上交它来立即完成任务。

blocks.en: Rewards
blocks.zh: 奖励

blocks.en: The career agent missions reward a moderate amount of ISK (about 5-6M ISK in total), as well as a number of useful ships and modules. Additionally, completing the last mission for each of the five career agents increases your standings with the agent's faction (with no derived standing). While this is only slightly useful for new characters (who start off with neutral standings to all the empire factions), it's a way for older characters to recover from low faction standings. Lastly, the completion of your first Career agents provides you with a free AIR Expert system, which temporarily gives you a significant boost to your skills of the respective career path. The expert systems are rewarded through the Air Career Programme.
blocks.zh: 生涯代理人任务会奖励适量的 ISK（总计约 5-6M ISK），以及一些有用的舰船和装备。此外，完成五位生涯代理人各自的最后一个任务，会提升你对该代理人所属势力的声望（不会产生衍生声望）。这对新角色（初始时对所有帝国势力的声望都是中立）来说用处不大，但对老角色来说是挽回较低势力声望的一种方式。最后，完成你的第一位生涯代理人的任务会获得一个免费的 AIR 专家系统，在一段时间内大幅提升你在相应职业方向上的技能。专家系统通过 AIR 职业计划发放。

blocks.en: Blitzing for faction standings
blocks.zh: 速刷势力声望

blocks.en: New players are strongly advised to disregard this section. Career Agents act as an extension to the EVE tutorial, and new players should take their time to work through a single set of career agent missions as they were intended, at their own pace, for the learning experience they offer.
blocks.zh: 强烈建议新玩家忽略本节。生涯代理人是 EVE 教程的延伸，新玩家应该按照设计初衷，按自己的节奏慢慢完成一组生涯代理人任务，从中学习。

blocks.en: For experienced players looking to gain faction standings fast, career agent missions offer significant faction standing gains (7.5% per set, with 12 sets available = 22.5% per faction) for relatively low effort and there are a number of tips and tricks that can greatly improve the speed at which you burn through the missions:
blocks.zh: 对于想快速提升势力声望的老玩家来说，生涯代理人任务花费的精力相对较少，却能带来可观的势力声望提升（每组 7.5%，共 12 组 = 每个势力 22.5%），而且有不少技巧可以大大加快刷任务的速度：

blocks.en: Every character can complete all three sets of career agent missions for each faction. Note: unlike Epic Arcs, career agent missions are never repeatable. You can accept a mission from each of the 5 agents in a location at once, and attempt to complete all 5 before returning to station, thus reducing your overall warps.
blocks.zh: 每个角色都可以完成每个势力的全部三组生涯代理人任务。注意：与史诗任务线不同，生涯代理人任务永远不能重复。你可以同时接下同一地点 5 位代理人的任务，争取一次出站就全部完成再回站，从而减少总的跃迁次数。

blocks.en: T1 Destroyers are within ship restrictions for most missions, and can be used to complete objectives, particularly combat related tasks, significantly faster than frigates, due to their increased firepower and abundance of high slots.
blocks.zh: 大多数任务的舰船限制都允许使用 T1 驱逐舰，由于火力更强、高槽更多，用它完成任务目标（尤其是战斗类任务）比护卫舰快得多。

en: Look to fit long range weapons as none of the NPCs will attempt to escape.
Prioritise velocity, warp speed and align time over tank, as most NPCs have low damage output.
3+ mid slots is ideal, to retain a prop mod, where combinations of 5 missions require you undock with the other two taken by mission specific modules.
Two career agent missions will destroy your ship, ensure you do these in ships you're happy to lose.
The two which destroy your ship, will notify you inside the mission dialogue.
zh: 尽量装配远程武器，因为没有任何 NPC 会试图逃跑。
优先考虑速度、跃迁速度和对准时间，而不是坦度，因为大多数 NPC 的伤害输出都很低。
最好有 3 个以上的中槽，以便保留一个推进装备，因为同时进行 5 个任务时，有些组合要求你离站时另外两个中槽装上任务指定的装备。
有两个生涯代理人任务会摧毁你的舰船，确保用你不介意损失的舰船来做。
这两个会摧毁你舰船的任务会在任务对话中提示你。

blocks.en: Not all rats / rooms need to be cleared. Many missions such as 'The Exam (10 of 10)' simply require you to kill a single target or destroy a single structure. Throughout the career missions, ensure you focus simply on the mission objective, complete this, then move onto the next mission and objective.
blocks.zh: 并不需要清掉所有海盗 NPC / 房间。许多任务（例如“The Exam (10 of 10)”）只要求你击杀单个目标或摧毁单个建筑。在整个生涯任务过程中，只需专注于任务目标，完成后就去做下一个任务和目标。

blocks.en: 'Aquire' missions, such as 'Making Mountains of Molehills (3 of 10)', which requires you hand in a 1MN Civilian Afterburner, can usually be completed instantly by purchasing the required item from the market, negating the need to use the supplied BPC.
blocks.zh: “获取”类任务，例如需要上交一个 1MN 民用加力燃烧器的“Making Mountains of Molehills (3 of 10)”，通常可以直接从市场购买所需物品立即完成，无需使用任务提供的蓝图拷贝。

en: The exception here are the missions requiring Tritanium, which require you to at least engage with the mission site before handing in.
zh: 例外的是需要三钛合金的任务，这些任务要求你至少先进入任务站点互动，然后才能上交。

blocks.en: Missions that require you fit a specific module, such as a Warp Scrambler for 'Your Undivided Attention (3 of 10)' will indicate this in your mission tracker, on the left hand side of your UI. Check your current fit meets the mission requirements for the set of 5 you have in progress, by clicking the white star icon for each mission you have accepted, prior to undocking (the icon in the top left corner, of the image to the right).
blocks.zh: 需要装配特定装备的任务，例如“Your Undivided Attention (3 of 10)”需要跃迁扰频器，会在界面左侧的任务追踪器中注明。离站之前，点击你已接的每个任务的白色星形图标（右图左上角的图标），检查当前装配是否满足正在进行的这组 5 个任务的要求。

blocks.en: Missions that suggest you board a Venture, can be completed in ships other than Ventures. This is simply a (good) suggestion to new players. If you wish to complete this mission in a different ship, you can still warp to the mission location after undocking.
blocks.zh: 建议你驾驶冲锋者级的任务，也可以用其他舰船完成。这只是给新玩家的一个（不错的）建议。如果你想用别的舰船完成这个任务，离站后照样可以跃迁到任务地点。

blocks.en: Scan down a few data, relic and gas training sites in one sitting. You can then unfit the probe launcher from your ship in favour of another weapon, and (provided the sites don't de-spawn) you can complete all the exploration missions without needing to scan again.
blocks.zh: 一次性扫出几个数据、遗迹和气云训练站点。然后你就可以把探针发射器从舰船上拆下来换成其他武器，（只要站点没有消失）无需再次扫描就能完成所有探索任务。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: February 2026: Version 23.02 2026-02-25.1 The final mission for each career agent, i.e. Making Mountains of Molehills (10 of 10) has had the faction standing bonus changed when completing the mission to no longer trigger derived standings, just like epic arcs. This will mean players will no longer lose standings to empire factions when completing the career agent missions.It should be noted that players who have already started or previously talked to a specific career agent will still get the derived standing standings from their final mission.
blocks.zh: 2026 年 2 月：23.02 版本 2026-02-25.1 每位生涯代理人的最后一个任务（例如 Making Mountains of Molehills (10 of 10)）完成时的势力声望奖励已经修改，和史诗任务线一样不再触发衍生声望。这意味着玩家完成生涯代理人任务时不会再损失对帝国势力的声望。需要注意的是，已经开始或之前与某位生涯代理人交谈过的玩家，在完成其最后一个任务时仍会获得衍生声望。
